A magnet separates magnetic materials such as iron filings from nonmagnetic materials.
Evaporation or boiling can recover dissolved salt from saltwater.
Boiling water changes into water vapor.
Filtration is used to purify water.
Decantation separates immiscible liquids like oil and water by pouring off the top layer.
A mixture forms when two or more substances are combined physically.
Homogeneous mixtures have evenly distributed components and a uniform appearance.
Heterogeneous mixtures have unevenly distributed components that can be distinguished.
